title: IC-TROSA POINT-TO-MULTIPOINT OPTICAL NETWORK SYSTEM
notes: MISIDENTIFIED IN DISCOVERY — NOT AN ICOTROKINRA PATENT. The real WO2023212427A1 is an optical-network patent by Dell Products LP (PCT/US2023/060882, IPC H04B10/...), unrelated to IL-23 / icotrokinra. The discovery agent labeled this number as an icotrokinra 'oral peptide' PCT, but that is INCORRECT (discovery itself noted Google Patents was not directly fetchable). The actual Janssen/Protagonist oral-formulation PCT does NOT carry this number. FLAG FOR HUMAN REVIEW: the correct WO number for the icotrokinra oral-formulation filing was not source-confirmed and should be re-discovered; do not use WO2023212427 for icotrokinra.
